description: Source code for MCP970X temperature sensor driver in Zephyr RTOS, including initialization, data fetching, and temperature calculation functions.

methods.name: fetch
methods.description: Fetches ADC data for the sensor device.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Converts raw ADC data to temperature in Celsius.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the sensor device, sets up ADC channel and sequence.
